user.title: P2PQuake WebSocket
user.description: Fires the p2pquake_eew event when an Earthquake Early Warning (code 556) is received, and the p2pquake_quake event for earthquake information (code 551). Choose the sandbox to test.

abort.single_instance_allowed: P2PQuake WebSocket is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

data_description.image: Creates image.p2pquake_ws_eew_map for each EEW and image.p2pquake_ws_quake_map for each earthquake information message (1280x800 PNG). Images are made after the event is fired, so events are never delayed.
data_description.home_area: Area shown large on the image (forecast intensity and arrival time for EEW, observed intensity for earthquake information). If empty, the areas with the strongest shaking are listed.

sandbox_endpoint.title: P2PQuake WebSocket is connected to the sandbox
sandbox_endpoint.description: The sandbox replays 2023 data and does not deliver real Earthquake Early Warnings. Switch the endpoint back to production in the integration options when you finish testing.

image_assets.title: Image files could not be loaded
image_assets.description: The map, observation-point table or font files could not be loaded, so no images (image.p2pquake_ws_eew_map etc.) are being created. EEW and earthquake information events are still fired as usual. Re-download the integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant.
